notes: The two pages state different tuition fees: the DAAD page says 8,200 EUR per semester for applicants from all countries, while the programme page says 8,600 EUR per semester; the tuition fact includes both quotes. Requirements for a Moroccan applicant: no subject-specific rule is given; the school-leaving certificate and other documents are submitted directly to the school, no uni-assist route is mentioned, so the application channel is likely de-university-direct, but the pages do not literally name uni-assist, hence no applicationChannel fact is stated. No translation requirement for documents is mentioned.
